mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE status=#{status}

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, created_at, published_at) / 1000000), 0) FROM outbox_event WHERE status='published' AND published_at IS NOT NULL AND published_at >= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)-INTERVAL 24 HOUR
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sensor_agent WHERE status='active' AND last_heartbeat_at>=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)-INTERVAL 3 MINUTE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sensor_agent WHERE status='active' AND (last_heartbeat_at IS NULL OR last_heartbeat_at<UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)-INTERVAL 3 MINUTE)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quality_status='accepted'),0) accepted, COALESCE(SUM(quality_status='manual_review'),0) manual_review, COALESCE(SUM(quality_status='rejected'),0) rejected FROM ingest_record WHERE created_at>=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)-INTERVAL 24 HOUR
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_login_throttle WHERE blocked_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(failed_attempts), 0) FROM auth_login_throttle WHERE updated_at>=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)-INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
